page.content:
WWE's spring showcase and the company's founding national gamble.

How WrestleMania connects

  • Topic: WWE — WrestleMania is WWE's annual showcase event.
  • Character: Vince McMahon — Vince McMahon gambled the company on the first WrestleMania.
  • Character: Hulk Hogan — Hulk Hogan main-evented the first WrestleMania at Madison Square Garden.
  • Character: The Undertaker — The Undertaker's WrestleMania streak became company myth.
  • Location: Madison Square Garden — The first WrestleMania was staged at Madison Square Garden.
  • Character: Becky Lynch — Becky Lynch main-evented WrestleMania 35.
  • Event: Royal Rumble — Winning the Royal Rumble books a WrestleMania world-title match.

What is WrestleMania?

WrestleMania I in 1985 at Madison Square Garden was Vince McMahon's closed-circuit bet. The show became the annual destination for title changes, streak myths, and stadium main events.

Key threads lead to WWE, Vince McMahon, Hulk Hogan, The Undertaker, Madison Square Garden and Becky Lynch.
